newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to clear Air France 1.0 bln franc aid - tranche.
newsitem.headline: EU to clear Air France 1.0 bln franc aid - tranche.

text.p: The European Commission is set to clear on Wednesday the final, 1.0-billion-franc tranche of aid to Air France, a senior official told Reuters on Friday.

"Air France is for the time being on course financially. Their results are even slightly better than what was predicted," the official said, saying the Commission would therefore approve payment of the outstanding money.
Last July, the Commission approved the last five billion francs of a 20-billion-franc aid package for Air France but froze one billion pending a progress review on restructuring.
The Commission has received no repeats of price leadership complaints about the French airline as raised last year by airlines SAS, Lufthansa and KLM, the official said.
"This year we have checked with them and they say they have no comment to make," the official added.
While Wednesday's decision may signal the end of Commission clearances for the original 1994 Air France rescue package, the story is by no means over.
The European Court of First Instance is due shortly to hear airlines' legal complaints about the original approval itself, which, if accepted, could reopen the whole issue.
